C0855.title: Ransomware-as-a-Service Lowers the Barrier to Entry for Attacks
C0855.summary: In August 2021, Tencent Research Institute highlighted that Ransomware-as-a-Service (RaaS) has become a new model for cyberattacks. The ransomware black market features clear hierarchies and full-chain collaboration, where developers update malware and distributors at various levels can share profits with just a few clicks.
